summary: Comprehensive architectural implementation plan for Dhruva - The Unified Job Operating System. Covers Phase 1 (Auth, OTP with timer/rate-limiting, Job Seeker & Company onboarding, AI resume parsing, in-app resume builder, real webcam biometric face liveness & ID verification, location sharing) with an Apple HIG-inspired design system, switchable mobile device frame & desktop company dashboard, dual INR/USD currency listings, and end-to-end data models.
